app: Restaurant management app for the manager and the staff: shifts and time clock, tasks and checklists, stock and supplier orders (and more, per the friend's handoff).
source: App Client Map research (restaurant management app), 24 Nov 2026. Prices = first year (setup + 12 months), estimates. See lead_agent/RESEARCH.md.
look_means: The first screen to show in the demo for this kind of restaurant.

quadrant_rule.note: price = geometric middle of lo..hi, first year (setup + 12 months)

approach.sweet: Easy and pays well. Lead with the weekly pain they feel: the shift board on WhatsApp, the tips and hours sheet at month-end, stock running out mid-service. Offer a 10-minute demo with their own week and a free trial with one team.
approach.volume: Easy but cheap. Sell the core: shifts, time clock and checklists. Set up in a day, simple monthly price. Get to a yes or no in one call.
approach.bigfish: Hard but pays well. Credibility first: ask what they use today (Restigo, MarketMan, Excel, WhatsApp groups), show a demo built for several branches or events, reach the owner or operations manager, expect 2-3 meetings and offer a pilot in one branch.
approach.skip: Too small: a notebook and WhatsApp are enough for them. Only if the user picks it; then sell just the time clock and hours report.

types.name: Busy sit-down restaurants (20+ staff)
types.why: Waiters, kitchen and bar on weekly shifts, tips to split every month, and stock that runs out mid-service. The owner or GM feels all of it.
types.look: This week's shift board with gaps in red, tonight's tips per waiter, and items running low.
types.pitch: The shift board, the time clock, the tips and the stock in one app, instead of WhatsApp and Excel.
types.pitch_he: סידור העבודה, שעון הנוכחות, הטיפים והמלאי באפליקציה אחת, במקום וואטסאפ ואקסל.

types.name: Busy cafés (10-25 staff)
types.why: Lots of young part-time staff, constant shift swaps, new people every few months, and the same opening checklist every morning.
types.look: Who's on today, open swap requests, and the opening checklist with ticks.
types.pitch: Shift swaps and the opening checklist from the phone, without chasing anyone on WhatsApp.
types.pitch_he: החלפות משמרות וצ'קליסט פתיחה מהטלפון, בלי לרדוף אחרי אף אחד בוואטסאפ.

types.name: Bars & pubs
types.why: Night shifts, tips split every night, and alcohol stock where every missing bottle is money. The owner works nights, so call in the afternoon.
types.look: Tonight's team, tonight's tips split, and the bottle count against last week.
types.pitch: The night's tips split in a minute, and a bottle count that shows where stock disappears.
types.pitch_he: חלוקת הטיפים של הערב בדקה, וספירת בקבוקים שמראה לאן נעלם המלאי.

types.name: Bakeries & production kitchens
types.why: Shifts from 4 a.m., daily production lists, flour and butter ordered from suppliers every day, and food-safety logs.
types.look: Tomorrow's production list, the early shift, and today's supplier order ready to send.
types.pitch: The production list, the early shift and the supplier orders ready every morning, without a notebook.
types.pitch_he: רשימת הייצור, המשמרת של הבוקר וההזמנות מהספקים מוכנות כל בוקר, בלי מחברת.

types.name: Pizza, burger & delivery kitchens
types.why: Counter, kitchen and couriers on shifts, prep checklists before every rush, and food cost that eats the margin left after delivery-app commission.
types.look: Tonight's shifts incl. couriers, the prep checklist, and the stock of dough, meat or fish.
types.pitch: Shifts, prep checklists and stock in one place, so the rush starts ready.
types.pitch_he: משמרות, צ'קליסט הכנות ומלאי במקום אחד, כדי שהעומס יתחיל כשהכול מוכן.

types.name: Fast-casual counters
types.he: דלפקי אוכל מהיר: סלטים, כריכים, קערות
types.why: Small counter teams, prep and cleaning checklists, and fresh stock that goes bad fast.
types.look: Today's prep list, who's on, and fresh stock with use-by dates.
types.pitch: Prep and cleaning checklists that get done, and fresh stock that doesn't go to waste.
types.pitch_he: צ'קליסטים של הכנות וניקיון שבאמת מתבצעים, ומלאי טרי שלא נזרק.

types.name: Ice cream & juice bars
types.why: Seasonal teams of teenagers every summer: new people to train, many swaps, simple stock.
types.look: This week's summer team, swap requests, and the training checklist for new staff.
types.pitch: The summer team trained and scheduled from the phone.

types.name: Small local chains (2-5 branches)
types.why: The biggest budgets: one view of every branch's shifts, hours, stock and checklists. Partners or an ops manager decide, and some already use Restigo or MarketMan.
types.look: All branches side by side: staffing gaps, hours this month, stock alerts, checklists done.
types.pitch: Every branch's shifts, hours, stock and checklists on one screen.
types.pitch_he: המשמרות, השעות, המלאי והצ'קליסטים של כל הסניפים במסך אחד.

types.name: Event halls & catering kitchens
types.why: Dozens of temporary workers per event, irregular shifts, big supplier orders per event. Big budgets, but complex and slow to decide.
types.look: The next event's team and shifts, the event checklist, and the supplier order for it.
types.pitch: Every event's team, checklist and supplier order ready from one app.
types.pitch_he: הצוות, הצ'קליסט וההזמנה מהספקים לכל אירוע מוכנים מאפליקציה אחת.

types.name: Chef restaurants
types.why: Food cost and recipes matter most, but many already run Restigo or MarketMan and the chef-owner is hard to reach.
types.look: Food cost per dish, this week's supplier prices, and kitchen checklists.
types.pitch: Food cost per dish and supplier prices in front of you, plus shifts and checklists.
types.pitch_he: עלות מנה ומחירי ספקים מול העיניים, יחד עם משמרות וצ'קליסטים.

types.name: Delivery-only & multi-brand kitchens
types.why: Several brands from one kitchen: shared stock, shifts across brands and tight food cost. Few of them, and hard to find on the map.
types.look: Stock shared across brands, tonight's kitchen shift, and food cost per brand.
types.pitch: One kitchen, several brands: shared stock and shifts finally in one place.
types.pitch_he: מטבח אחד וכמה מותגים: מלאי ומשמרות משותפים סוף-סוף במקום אחד.

types.name: Small family places (up to 6 staff)
types.he: מקומות משפחתיים קטנים: שווארמה, פלאפל, חומוס
types.why: A handful of family workers, a notebook and WhatsApp are enough for them. Small budget.
types.look: Just the time clock and the monthly hours report.
types.pitch: A time clock and a monthly hours report that keep you covered.
types.pitch_he: שעון נוכחות ודוח שעות חודשי שמגינים עליכם.
